tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. Never put body text directly on it in dense screens; use `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, nav bar. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and hovered cards — anything lifted above `surface`. Pair with `shadow-3`/`shadow-4`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: search fields, empty box slots, table header rows, code.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and list-item hover fill on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — captions, metadata, table headers — on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels on `surface` only (meets 4.5:1 there). Never for information people must read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outlined buttons (≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken`).

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: THE brand color. Primary buttons, active tab, selected states, links, the wordmark. Text on it uses `on-emerald`.

tokens.name: emerald-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for `emerald` fills, and emerald-colored text on `surface`/`canvas` (links, active nav).

tokens.name: emerald-deep
tokens.usage: The dark 'shader' green: hero bands, the cover, the run banner. Text on it uses `on-emerald-deep`.

tokens.name: emerald-sheen
tokens.usage: The reflective highlight. Thin accents only: progress fill on `emerald-deep`, a 2px top edge on featured cards, sparkle icons. Never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: emerald-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: selected rows, active filter chips, the alive chip. Text on it uses `emerald-strong`.

tokens.name: on-emerald
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `emerald` fills.

tokens.name: on-emerald-deep
tokens.usage: Text on `emerald-deep` bands.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Victory/achievement accent: badges cleared, run won, personal bests. A fill — text on it uses `on-gold`.

tokens.name: gold-strong
tokens.usage: Gold-colored text and icons on `surface` (e.g. 'Champion defeated').

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Soft gold chip background; text on it uses `gold-strong`.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold` fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, form errors, 'delete run'. Text and icons on `surface`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner background; text on it is `danger`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings ('level cap exceeded') — text/icons on `surface`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner background; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips — text/icons on `surface`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner background; text on it is `info`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Blue so it never vanishes against emerald.

tokens.name: state-alive
tokens.usage: Alive chip background. Paired with `state-alive-ink` and the heart-pulse icon. Light in both themes, so it never matches the dark fainted chip in lightness.

tokens.name: state-alive-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-alive`; also the alive color for icons alone on `surface`.

tokens.name: state-fainted
tokens.usage: Fainted chip background — the only DARK chip, so death reads heavy and is never told from alive by hue alone. Skull icon.

tokens.name: state-fainted-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-fainted`.

tokens.name: state-boxed
tokens.usage: Boxed (in the PC) chip background. Archive icon.

tokens.name: state-boxed-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-boxed`.

tokens.name: state-caught
tokens.usage: Caught (new encounter, not yet placed) chip background. Circle-check icon.

tokens.name: state-caught-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-caught`.

tokens.name: state-missed
tokens.usage: Missed / failed encounter chip background. Circle-slash icon. Deliberately grey: nothing was gained.

tokens.name: state-missed-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-missed`.

tokens.name: state-gift
tokens.usage: Gift Pokémon chip background. Gift icon.

tokens.name: state-gift-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-gift`.

tokens.name: state-trade
tokens.usage: In-game trade chip background. Arrow-left-right icon.

tokens.name: state-trade-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `state-trade`.

tokens.name: type-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on the light type fills (normal, fire, water, electric, grass, ice, ground, flying, psychic, bug, rock, steel, fairy); every pair ≥5.3:1.

tokens.name: type-on-light
tokens.usage: Text on the dark type fills (fighting, poison, ghost, dragon, dark); every pair ≥5.5:1.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-rounded, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero and the run-complete screen. One per page, at most.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page and dialog titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles and table group headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and empty states on roomy screens.
styles.sample: Track every catch, every loss, and every win.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy on roomy screens (home, search, box view, settings). Inputs use 16px on phones to stop iOS zoom.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.usage: Default copy on dense screens: fight planner, box selection, encounter tables.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text under fields.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small all-caps eyebrow above a section or stat. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number in a stat tile (deaths, badges, win rate). Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables: levels, HP, damage %, counts. Tabular figures, right-aligned.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Dense screens step by space-1/2/3; roomy screens by space-4/6/8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips; dense cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; dense cell padding (horizontal); icon-to-text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense screens; gap between form label and field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding; phone page gutter; gap between cards on dense screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on roomy screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on roomy screens; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding; space above a page title on roomy screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large empty-state and hero breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table cells that highlight, small buttons, type badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, mon slots in the box grid.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets on phones, the home hero.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State chips, filter chips, search field, toggles, avatars.

shadow.note: Cards lift off the page. Light theme: soft green-tinted shadows. Dark theme: deeper shadows plus a faint top highlight — the 'reflective' sheen.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, stat tiles, mon slots.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected cards; the sticky top bar once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Pokémon picker.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Dialogs and phone bottom sheets.

size.note: Control and row heights. Compact is for dense screens on a mouse; never go below 44px tap targets on phones.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and selects in dense tables (mouse only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height for anything tappable on phones.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Table rows on dense screens.

tokens.name: row-roomy
tokens.usage: List rows on roomy screens (search results, run list).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in chips, dense tables and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in nav and default buttons.

tokens.name: sprite-sm
tokens.usage: Pokémon sprite in table rows.

tokens.name: sprite-lg
tokens.usage: Pokémon sprite in box slots and team cards.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content on wide monitors.

breakpoint.note: Phone first. Layouts change at these widths.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Two-column card grids; tabs replace the bottom nav.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Side-by-side panels (e.g. box + details); dense tables show all columns.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Second-monitor layouts: three-column dashboards.
